component: DNS discovery tests and simple pipeline style

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: CalDAV and CardDAV tests changed their TXT mocks from data to strings, so discovery tests exercise the production object shape. CardDAV’s unusual fixture path distinguishes a TXT path from a default well-known path. The reviewed simple map/find/filter pipeline searches within records and drops missing paths. Review asked for bogus entries as well, but this six-file historical diff does not add an explicit multi-string-with-junk assertion; current inspected mocks also show a single path string. Do not claim those browser tests prove every multi-string parser edge. The old account-setup test path has since been removed.
title: Make DNS mocks use the same record shape as production
